finding.foundBy: prepare_review, independently confirmed by evm_activation_review source read
finding.cause: signed_wire() returns a const reference to private Bytes in a potentially nonconst caller-owned proof. A legal const_cast mutation before by-value API copying changes the wire; matches() authenticates stored header/post/profile but does not recheck wire bytes.
finding.concreteCounterexample: Construct a genuine proof p, mutate const_cast<Bytes&>(p.signed_wire())[4], then pass p by value to fresh typed constructor. The copied header/post remain valid while archive entry uses modified signature bytes.
finding.proposedNarrowRepair: Return signed_wire Bytes by value; optionally header by value so public proof accessors expose no mutable storage alias. Add meaningful pre-mutation copy test. No signature creation or consensus rule change.
